injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Tyler Bilodeau
injuries.detail: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Coby White
injuries.detail: White (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Kylan Boswell
injuries.detail: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.detail: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

injuries.name: Kyrie Irving
injuries.detail: Irving posted 24 points (8-15 FG, 5-10 3Pt, 3-3 FT), one rebound, three assists, one block and one steal over 25 minutes before fouling out of Friday's 121-105 win over Indiana.

injuries.name: Cooper Flagg
injuries.detail: Head coach Dusty May said Flagg (shoulder) will be evaluated in the next couple of days, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.detail: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Caleb Martin
injuries.detail: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out for Fridays' game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Jett Howard
injuries.detail: Howard (calf) is out for Friday's game in Indiana.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Cameron Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Spencer Jones
injuries.detail: Jones (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pelicans.

injuries.name: Alpha Diallo
injuries.detail: Diallo is questionable for Saturday's game versus the Pelicans due to a right wrist sprain.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Brandin Podziemski
injuries.detail: Podziemski (back) told reporters Friday that he will not play in the second leg of the Warriors' back-to-back set Saturday against the Suns, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.detail: Curry told reporters after Friday's loss to the Grizzlies that he will "probably not" play against the Suns on Saturday, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Charles Bassey
injuries.detail: Bassey (knee) is out for Friday's game versus the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Fred VanVleet
injuries.detail: VanVleet closed with six points (2-8 FG, 2-6 3Pt), two rebounds, 11 assists, one block and three steals in 30 minutes during Wednesday's 128-110 win over the Mavericks.

injuries.name: Reed Sheppard
injuries.detail: Sheppard (knee) is out for Friday's game in San Antonio.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.detail: Adams (calf) is available for Friday's game against San Antonio.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.detail: Missi won't return to Friday's game against the Jazz due to a left knee injury.

injuries.name: LeBron James
injuries.detail: James (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Dean Wade
injuries.detail: Wade is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks due to a left ankle sprain.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Tacko Fall
injuries.detail: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Luke Kennard
injuries.detail: Kennard (knee) is questionable to play Saturday against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Oso Ighodaro
injuries.detail: Ighodaro (oblique) is listed as doubtful for Saturday's game against Golden State.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: AJ Dybantsa
injuries.detail: Dybantsa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Raptors, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.
